newsitem.title: FRANCE: Centeon gets FDA distribution OK.
newsitem.headline: Centeon gets FDA distribution OK.

text.p: The Centeon joint-venture of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer and Germany's Hoechst AG said it had received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to resume distibution of blood plasm products produced at its Kankanee plant.
It plans to submit further samples in order to qualify for FDA approval to resume delivery of the products in the coming weeks.

Centeon withdrew voluntartily its products from the market due to risks of bacterial infection in October. Both Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, its parent Rhone-Poulenc SA and Hoechst have made heavy write-offs for the Centeon recall impact.
